title: Review
description: Full-viewport order review screen composing the description-list and order-summary blocks: the last step of checkout before the order is placed — the contact, address, delivery and payment the shopper chose, each with Change, beside a read-only recap of the lines and the totals — with Back to payment and Place order, and the place-order-failed, placing-order, loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container): the masthead and the buttons line up at @sm, the footer at @md, and the order summary moves beside the details at @lg; each block keeps reading its own container.
